run_update_version: run the script with a version string like 3.7.1 to update all protobuf version files
run_update_version_rc: run the script with a version and RC number like 3.7.1 2 to set a beta release
create_function_rewrite_xml: create a function that parses an XML file, applies a rewriter callback, and saves it back
create_function_rewrite_text_file: create a function that reads a text file line by line and applies a rewriter lambda to each line
create_function_get_full_version: create a function that returns the full version string with an optional RC suffix appended
